title: Self-Supervised Learning and Collapse
summary: Learn without labels and “the same answer for every input” scores a perfect loss. This article lines up SimCLR, BYOL, DINO, VICReg and I-JEPA against the single question of what blocks that trivial solution, maps collapse and its neighboring failures by unit of observation, explains why diagnostic metrics and downstream performance must be kept separate, and ends with the less visible failure where global representations look fine while patch-level structure disappears.
author: Seungheon Doh

title: Interactive Stochastic Differential Equations
summary: Random walks and Brownian motion, stochastic processes and the Markov property, Itô calculus and SDEs, and finally the Fokker–Planck equation and the probability flow ODE that underpins diffusion models.
author: Seungheon Doh

title: Interactive Differential Equations
summary: ODEs and their numerical solvers — direction fields, initial value problems, phase portraits, Euler and Runge–Kutta, and numerical stability — then PDEs: the transport, continuity and diffusion equations.
author: Seungheon Doh

title: Interactive Calculus
summary: Functions, limits, derivatives and the chain rule, Taylor expansion and integrals, then partial derivatives, the gradient, Jacobian, Hessian, vector fields, divergence and the Laplacian.
author: Seungheon Doh

title: Interactive Information Theory
summary: Self-information, entropy and coding length, cross-entropy and KL divergence, mutual information, and the losses built on them — cross-entropy, perplexity, the ELBO, and InfoNCE.
author: Seungheon Doh

title: Interactive Probability
summary: Random variables, joint and conditional distributions, expectation, the distributions machine learning actually uses, and the road from likelihood to NLL, Bayes' rule, and MAP.
author: Seungheon Doh

title: Interactive Linear Algebra
summary: Vectors, inner products, eigenvalues, the four fundamental subspaces, change of basis, and PyTorch einsum/permute/view/reshape.
author: Seungheon Doh
